profile.headline: Software engineer, investor, curler
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with more than a dozen years of experience writing code for companies of all sizes. I currently work as a software engineer for Code.org.

Outside of work, I also have recent experience as an angel investor, non-profit board member, treasurer, and volunteer.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Improving the teacher experience on the Code.org learning platform.

Major projects include:
* AI Teaching Assistant (back-to-back award winner in Best of STEM Awards)
* Progress tracking interface

Technologies used: Ruby on Rails, React, AWS, Amazon Bedrock

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building an online marketplace to sell bulk quantities of surplus and imperfect produce, taking a bite out of the food waste problem in the process.

Technologies used: React, JavaScript, Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to software used for administration of non-profit preschools.

Technologies used: Perl, JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer for Google's social graph backend. Responsible for systems that store Gmail contacts, Google profiles, and other related data. I spent some time working on ensuring appropriate access controls for this sensitive information, deleting obsolete data from the systems, adding support for a few new data types to support new use cases in the Google Assistant, and implementing a new service to store and serve contacts uploaded from mobile devices.

Technologies used: Java, C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineering on the Tableau core server team.

Major projects included:
* Internationalized Tableau Server UI.
* Email subscriptions on Tableau Server.

Technologies used: Java, Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Software development, maintenance, and operational support for Target,com, bebe.com, and Amazon Webstore.

Major projects included:
* Target.com shopping cart page improvements and redesign.
* Target shipment data feed re-engineering.
* Amazon Webstore catalog manager improvements to support multiple storefronts.
* Other currently unreleased projects for Amazon Webstore.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Graded programming projects, homework assignments, and exams, and assisted students for the following courses:
* CS 302 (Introduction to Programming with Java) – Fall 2007
* CS 367 (Introduction to Data Structures) – Spring 2008
* CS 537 (Introduction to Operating Systems) – Fall 2008
* CS 706 (Analysis of Software Artifacts) – Fall 2008
* CS 536 (Introduction to Programming Languages and Compilers) – Spring 2009

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Implemented front-end and back-end code for Google Website Optimizer. Built and launched a page validation feature, and also worked on an Ajax help text loader. Languages used: C++, JavaScript, ClearSilver, HTML, and CSS.

positions.title: Graphical Test Case Generator Speed Team Intern
positions.description: I developed the graphical user interface (in Perl/Tk) for an application that can generate automated test cases for IBM's Power Hypervisor without the need for the tester to write any code him/herself.

positions.title: Student Programmer
positions.description: I developed an application to record a user's actions in order to build an intelligent tutoring system for desktop computer applications. I also configured an online content management system for the company's web site.

positions.title: High Availability Speed Team Intern
positions.description: I worked on an i5/OS application to analyze a user's typical workload, and use that information to estimate the hardware requirements that would be needed if that workload were to be moved to a geographically mirrored redundant system.

positions.title: Firmware Testing Co-Op
positions.description: I performed automated tests for the initial program load function in the System i and System p firmware, and I also was responsible for maintaining my team's interactive test results web site.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Nov 2002

volunteerExperiences.description: Career education/advice for computer science students looking for their first jobs in the tech industry.

publications.title: Automatic Generation of Library Bindings Using Static Analysis

organizations.name: AI House
organizations.description: Participating in community events, being insightful from time to time.

organizations.name: E8 Angels
organizations.description: Member of an angel investing group focused on early stage companies that aim to move our planet toward a more sustainable future.
